message: Homepage feature panel updated: AI Music moved out of the lower bento area and replaced with a cleaner TUBAL HUB Shop panel.

changelog.title: Homepage Shop Panel
changelog.desc: The lower homepage feature panel now highlights the TUBAL HUB Shop instead of AI Music.

changelog.title: Three Shop Collections
changelog.desc: Quick access is provided for TUBAL HUB, Payapang Isip, and CTRLZONE collections.

changelog.title: Live Cart Summary
changelog.desc: The homepage Shop panel reads the current cart and wishlist counts from browser storage.

changelog.title: AI Music Moved to Studio
changelog.desc: AI Music remains available through its dedicated page and featured website area instead of occupying the lower homepage panel.
